messageFontFamilyInCollection.note: byEquals uses object identity; WPF returns a fresh FontFamily instance for SystemFonts, so identity is expected to be false even when the family is present - the meaningful comparisons are by name and by file.

rawSpi.readOnly: SPI_GET* and registry reads only; nothing was written, no theme was changed

textRenderingDefaults.note: TextOptions.GetTextFormattingMode on a fresh DependencyObject returns the process default that a TextBlock inherits when nothing sets it explicitly.

negativeControl.why: a family that does not exist must not resolve to a font file; otherwise the resolution check in this tool proves nothing
